reason: My family is without power half the day and I am the one paying from abroad, so written offers with brands, models and warranty that I can compare from here are exactly what I need. It is free, so I will send one request and see who answers.
objection: If I send a request and only one or two companies reply, or nobody replies at all, then the app is empty and I have wasted my time. I also cannot check from abroad that the installer actually puts in the brands written in the offer.
would_change_my_mind: If I open the app and see no real companies listed in Khartoum or Port Sudan, or no finished projects with ratings, I will not bother sending anything.
